title: Coordinatewise sum of lists
statement: Given a natural number $m$ and a list of lists of integers, start with the list of $m$ zeros and successively replace the current list by the pairwise sum with each list, truncating each pairwise sum to the length of the shorter list. The resulting list is the defined sum.
hypotheses_covered: A list of lists of integers
